name: Cyber Conversion
oracle_text: Turn target creature face down. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
blocked_sentences: Turn target creature face down. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.

needs.what: an op that turns a permanent already on the battlefield face down (708.2), so it loses its name, mana cost, colors, abilities, subtypes and printed P/T and becomes a nameless, colorless 2/2 face-down permanent with a characteristics override (here: artifact creature, subtype Cyberman); it stays face down indefinitely and may be turned face up only if it has morph/disguise/a face-up cost (708.8)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: turn_face_up exists only in the other direction; manifest, manifest_dread and cloak (manifest's flag) put cards from the library face down, not a permanent already on the battlefield; face_down on look_at_top/return_from_graveyard only puts cards onto the battlefield face down from another zone; animate or set_pt plus lose_all_abilities and add_subtype would approximate the result but leave the name, colors, mana value and face-up status intact and would not make it a face-down permanent the face_down selector or turn_face_up reads
